watson.linePrev: I have seen the David, I've seen the Mona Lisa too
watson.line: I have heard Doc Watson play "Columbus Stockade Blues"
watson.lineNext: Forgive me all my anger, forgive me all my faults
stanza: I have been to Fort Worth and I have been to Spain
I have been too proud to come in out of the rain
I have seen the David, I've seen the Mona Lisa too
I have heard Doc Watson play "Columbus Stockade Blues"
